column1: # Reviewed exceptions to the downloaded lists (decisions D55, D56). domain<TAB>action; a domain
# covers its subdomains. Lines starting with # are comments. Kept by the refresh script.
#   neutral  ignore the domain's Wikipedia Perennial sources status (no reliability factor)
#   allow    lift a spam-list or Perennial deprecated/blacklisted block
# An override never lifts an unsafe (security) list block, the user's own block or
# enigma-blocked.txt, and leaves the authority and unreadable factors alone.
# Decision D57: crowdfunding and petition sites, flagged only by Wikipedia's link-spam blacklist.
# Decision D57: keep the authority bonus of preprint servers and AWS docs from being cancelled.
